text:
Aisha: Morning folks — spontaneous question: who’s up for an absurd combo this weekend? :doughnut: sunrise doughnut run (6:30am) OR a silent forest walk and thermos tea (8am). I can be convinced by either.
Ben: both sound great tbh. doughnuts if it’s short, forest if we can linger. :evergreen_tree:
Carmen: I vote forest. need the quiet. also bringing my thermos. anyone want to carpool?
Derek: @Ben I’m down for early doughnuts if you bring coffee. otherwise forest for me too.
lunchbot: Reminder: Friday doughnut stand at HQ closes at 11am. :alarm_clock:
Aisha: Ooh thanks @lunchbot — good to know. Carmen — can you DM route?
Carmen: sure, dropping coordinates and a tiny map: ```meet at Evergreen Trailhead (lat: 47.621, lon: -122.350) then we’ll walk east 1.2mi```
Ben: I’ll take doughnuts if y’all choose that path. bringing Kodiak pastries. :raised_hands:
Derek: whichever wins I’ll bring a pack of instant coffee + a thermos of hot water. :coffee:
Aisha: Poll time — react with :doughnut: for doughnuts, :evergreen_tree: for forest. whoever has more reactions decides! :grin:
